title: specy-road worker event
description: One line of work/.workers/<worker-id>.events.jsonl: the append-only, sequence-numbered log the coordinator syncs from. Summaries are short; a detail object may carry more, never a transcript.

type.description: api_retry and permission_denied are parsed from the harness's stream (worker_suggestion); post_run_check is written exactly once per turn and lists the check's findings (an empty detail.findings for a clean turn); usage_limited records a usage limit recognised during the turn, with detail.reset_at (UTC ISO 8601 or null), detail.evidence and detail.source (the harness line it was read from, or watchdog when the retry watchdog stopped the harness); the turn then ends in paused_by_limit with the record's limit_reset_at set from it.

authority.description: system = a lifecycle fact the toolkit itself observed (start, exit code, READY check); worker_suggestion = anything parsed from the harness's output (session ids, assistant text, tool summaries, its own result line).

epoch.description: instruction_epoch of the worker when the event was written.

usage.description: One turn's token counts and cost, the same shape for every harness. A field the harness did not report is null, never 0. input_tokens includes cached_input_tokens (tokens read from cache). cost_usd is this turn's: a harness that reports the session's running total (Claude Code; a Codex price estimate) also records it as session_cost_usd, and cost_usd is the difference from the previous usage event. Token counts are this turn's too: Codex reports the thread's running totals on a resume, recorded as session_usage, and the four counts are the difference from the previous usage event's (a lower total counts whole).

cost_is_estimate.description: true for a client-side figure that can differ from the bill; null when there is no cost.

num_turns.description: The harness's own count of model turns in this run, when it reports one.

session_usage.description: The session's running token totals as the harness reported them (Codex), before the difference was taken.
